texto: To indicate that you have a prior reservation: «Ik heb een kamer gereserveerd» (I have reserved a room). At reception you will be asked for the data: «Wat is uw naam?» and you will present your documents: «Hier is mijn paspoort» (Here is my passport). To guide you in the building: «Het ontbijt is beneden» (Breakfast is served below). Travel vocabulary: «de reis» (travel), «het hotel» (hotel), «de bagage» (luggage).

frases.nl: Goedemiddag. Ik heb een kamer gereserveerd.
frases.es: Buenas tardes. He reservado una habitación.
frases.en: Good afternoon. I've booked a room.

frases.nl: Mijn naam is Noor. Hier is mijn paspoort.
frases.es: Me llamo Noor. Aquí está mi pasaporte.
frases.en: My name is Noor. Here's my passport.

frases.nl: Dank u. Het ontbijt is beneden.

bloques.pregunta: How do you say «travel» in Dutch?

opciones.explicacion: It is the hotel establishment («het hotel»).
He formally asks the guest's name with the possessive «uw».

opciones.texto: Do you have a confirmed reservation for two nights?
Where did you leave your luggage by hand?

opciones.explicacion: «Een kamer reserveren» is booking a hotel room.
It means the hotel building itself.

bloques.frase: Mijn naam is Noor. Hier is mijn paspoort.

opciones.texto: My name is Noor. Here's my passport.
opciones.explicacion: It gives its name and gives the required documentation.

opciones.texto: I'm Noor. I forgot my passport on the train.
I come with my family and two big bags.

bloques.frase: Goedemiddag. Ik heb een kamer gereserveerd
bloques.traduccion: Good afternoon. I've booked a room.
bloques.explicacion: I greet courteous, followed by a phrase with participle gereserveerd at the end.

bloques.pregunta: What verb does «book» mean in infinitive?

bloques.frase: Dank u. Het ontbijt is beneden.

opciones.explicacion: Thank you and indicate the location of the breakfast service («beneden»).

opciones.texto: Thank you. Your room is on the second floor.
opciones.explicacion: He's not talking about the floor of the room.

opciones.texto: You're welcome. The restaurant opens at eight.
opciones.explicacion: He doesn't mention a restaurant or an hour.

intro: We learn to make the arrival record in a hotel and to present the travel documentation.
